task_instance: Given 9 pasted rows of public Shopify App Store reviews (rating | app | date | reviews URL | text) across a small 3-app portfolio plus 1 competitor row, apply the SKILL.md rubric's five-bucket keyword sort (P0 incident risk, P1 repeated friction, P2 pricing confusion, P3 feature request, needs human read), apply the tie-break/escalation rules (secondary-match annotation, 3-rows-in-60-days repetition escalation, competitor exclusion from the team's own P0), and produce the P0-P3 markdown brief the skill specifies, with every item carrying a source link or 'not captured', first-pass/not-human-checked labeling, and reviewer-report phrasing.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/github__awesome-copilot__shopify-review-triage . Files produced: input_rows.txt, triage.py, triage_output.json, brief.md. Created input_rows.txt (9 fictional 5-field review rows across Popup Boost, Currency Converter Pro, Reviews Widget, plus 1 competitor row for RivalApp Currency X). Wrote triage.py, a local Python script implementing the SKILL.md rubric's keyword lists verbatim (lower-cased, curly-apostrophe-normalized, apostrophe-dropped variants), ran `python3 triage.py input_rows.txt > triage_output.json` and inspected the JSON to confirm each row's primary/secondary bucket (rows 1,2,3 -> P0; rows 4,5,9 -> P1 via 'confusing'; row 6 -> P2; row 7 -> P3; row 8 -> no match/needs human read; row 10 competitor -> P0 keyword but routed to competitor watch per the skill's explicit rule). Verified the repetition tie-break: 'confusing' hit 3 rows (4,5,9) within about 5 weeks, so per rule 2 in SKILL.md that theme was escalated from P1 to P0 in the final brief and P1 is empty. Wrote brief.md following the SKILL.md template exactly: scope line with row count and no coverage claim, every item labeled 'first pass - not human-checked', a Reproduced field on P0 items, reviewer-report phrasing ('the reviewer reports...'), a source link or 'not captured' on every item, the escalated cluster item citing all 3 driving rows, the competitor's P0-shaped review placed only in 'Competitor watch' (never in the team's P0 section), and a closing known-limits note plus a no-promises/no-coverage-claim posture throughout. Manually re-checked brief.md against every box in the skill's Self-check section (bucket/priority sourced only from the rubric, source-or-not-captured on every item, no invented rating/date/app/URL/text, first-pass labeling everywhere, report-phrased claims, scope line with row count and no exhaustive-coverage claim, no revenue/outcome/compliance promises, no private data, nothing sent or posted) - all satisfied. No network access, credentials, or MCP/connector tools were needed or used, matching the skill's stated 'pure reasoning over pasted rows' design.
